description: A geometry library for engineering drawings and models, in two dimensions and in three. Points, vectors, lines, polylines, polygons, faces with holes, circles and oriented rectangles in the plane; points, planes, triangles, polygons, faces, solids, boxes, coordinate systems and transformations in space. Over both: distance, projection, containment, intersection, collision, parallelism, parametrization, merging, splitting, extending and trimming, offsetting, and boolean operations. It also carries the label placement that arranges drawing labels clear of each other and of blocked regions, and packs boxes such as drawing views onto sheets of paper. Every comparison is tolerance-aware, because coordinates that come out of a BIM model are never exact.
releaseNotes:
NEW IN 12.0.0

      BREAKING, label placement keeps the greedy algorithm alone
      - ArrangeAlgorithmType and ArrangeOptions.Algorithm are removed, with MaxBacktrackSteps,
        AnnealingInitialTemperature, AnnealingCoolingRate and ForceIterations, the options only the other four read.
        The greedy placement, the default all along, places every label where it did, bit for bit. Delete the Algorithm
        line and those options; code that chose another algorithm gets the greedy placement.

      NEW, net volumes of a model's parts
      - GeometryHelper.Takeoff: VolumeTakeoff.Run takes off the volume of each part with every bit of material counted
        once, by the part ranked first among those holding it: the higher VolumeItem.Priority, then the larger
        VolumeItem.Id, then the earlier in the list. Only what the parts share is cut, never the parts. What the
        booleans cannot make is worked out by exact slicing. It runs in parallel, the same bit for bit on any number of
        threads. On a Tekla model of 30 921 parts it keeps 67 369.17 m3 net of 69 040.90 m3 gross, no part carrying an
        issue, in 197 seconds on 24 processors.

      NEW, ellipses
      - GeoEllipse2, an ellipse as a region, with Core.Ellipse2: area, length, lengths along the rim, containment, the
        nearest point, distances, crossings and collisions against every shape a circle takes and against another
        ellipse, transformations, flattening by curvature, triangles and meshes.

      NEW, angles
      - Angle.ToReadableDegrees and Angle.ToReadableRadians turn the angle of a text the way up it reads, within a
        tolerance of a tenth of a radian unless given, as Tekla Structures takes it.

      FIXED
      - A circle or a coplanar arc in space a hair inside another, within the point tolerance of touching it, touches
        it between the two rims where they come nearest, not at a point read off the radical line, and an arc of it is
        no longer missed.
      - A boolean with a contact no longer throws when putting the second body onto the first leaves too little of it
        to build a body.

      Details in CHANGELOG.md.

      Earlier releases: https://github.com/nguyenthanguth/GeometryHelper/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
